title: Beginner Five-Finger Warmup
description: Build comfort with the right-hand C major five-finger position.
overview: This is a right-hand warmup. Right-hand five-finger position places your thumb on C and one finger on each white key through G.
goal: Connect right-hand finger position with the first five white keys of C major.
instructions: Keep your right hand relaxed over C, D, E, F, and G.
Play the highlighted note or note pair.
Release before the next target appears.

fingering.note: Finger numbers start at your thumb: 1 thumb, 2 index, 3 middle, 4 ring, 5 pinky.
